checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.why: Same pose, face, proportions and tail.

must.item: Retains orange hoodie and friendly look
must.why: The hoodie is recolored to hot pink/salmon by the neon light; only faint orange remains. The friendly face is kept.
Ears to feet are visible with margin.
Pink-to-teal sky, striped sun, pink grid floor and neon glow all match the reference.
The image is square and has no letters.

faults.what: The orange hoodie, and the fox's fur, are shifted to pink, so the hoodie no longer reads as orange as requested.
The striped sun is mostly hidden behind the fox's head and body, so it reads less clearly than in the reference.

summary: A clean, square, text-free vaporwave version of the same fox with full body and neon glow, but the orange hoodie turned mostly pink.
